prompts.confirmArchive: Block this employee? History and screenshots will be preserved.

enrollment.title: Install ActiLens for {{name}}
enrollment.description: Create a short-lived one-time enrollment code. The raw code is shown only here; the server stores only its hash. Creating a new code revokes the previous unused code.
enrollment.oneTime: The code can be redeemed only once. The command downloads the ActiLens installer, sets the server URL and enrollment code, installs the app and launches it.
enrollment.failed: Could not create an enrollment code.
enrollment.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
enrollment.serverUrlHelp: If the console is open through localhost, enter the LAN server URL, for example http://192.168.0.249:8081.

purge.title: Permanently delete {{name}}
purge.warning: This action cannot be undone. Activity, browser history, keystroke counts, screenshots and screenshot files for this member in the selected organization will be deleted.
purge.scope: Administrative audit history is retained. If the account is used in another organization, that organization's data and access are not affected.
purge.failed: The member could not be fully deleted. Retry the operation; partially removed files are handled safely.

lifecycle.noFormerDescription: Members removed from this organization will appear here while their retained history remains available.
lifecycle.removeWarning: This removes organization access and stops future monitoring, but it does not delete retained history.
lifecycle.removeScope: The member will move to Former members. Owner/Admin can still view retained history, restore the member later, or permanently purge organization-scoped data.
lifecycle.restoreInfo: The same account and retained history will be restored. The member returns with the Employee role.
lifecycle.restoreMonitoringHelp: If disabled, the member is restored but managed monitoring remains off until an administrator enables it.
lifecycle.readOnly: This organization is archived and read-only. Historical reports, members, former members and devices remain available until it is restored or deleted.

newEmployeeModal.noBusinessSelected: Select or create an organization before adding this {{member}}.
newEmployeeModal.shareCredentials: Share these credentials with the {{member}}; they sign in from the desktop app's login picker.
newEmployeeModal.errorTaken: That email or username is already taken.

detail.noBusinessContext: Open this page from the Dashboard or Employees list so the business context is known.

detail.errorStartAfterEnd: The start date is after the end date.

devices.deviceLimitReached: This device cannot be restored because the organization active-device limit is already reached. Revoke another device or increase the organization limit.
devices.reenrollHint: To use this computer again as a new installation, generate a fresh enrollment code.
